name: Button
description: Primary, ghost and soft actions with clear labels.

name: Card
description: Elevated container grouping related content.

name: Tab Bar
description: iOS bottom navigation with icon and label tabs.

name: Bottom Sheet
description: Slide-up panel presenting details over the current screen.

name: Modal
description: Centered dialog demanding a decision before continuing.

name: Search Bar
description: Rounded query field with icon and placeholder.

name: Carousel
description: Horizontally snapping row of cards.

name: Toggle
description: On/off switch for a single setting.

name: Slider
description: Draggable track for choosing a value in a range.

name: Progress Bar
description: Linear fill showing completion toward a goal.

name: Avatar
description: Circular identity mark with initials or photo.

name: Badge
description: Small pill highlighting status, counts or promos.

name: Chip
description: Compact filter or category selector.

name: FAB
description: Floating action button for the screen’s primary action.

name: Segmented Control
description: Inline switcher between two to four views.

name: List Item
description: Row with icon, title, subtitle and optional chevron.

name: Text Field
description: Labeled input with placeholder and icon support.

name: Checkbox
description: Multi-select square with label.

name: Radio
description: Single-select circle within a group.

name: Dropdown
description: Collapsed selector revealing options on tap.

name: Date Picker
description: Strip or grid for choosing calendar dates.

name: Chart
description: Bar, line, ring or donut visualisation of data.

name: Skeleton
description: Shimmering placeholder shown while content loads.

name: Toast
description: Transient confirmation message floating above content.

name: Banner
description: Inline informational strip with icon and dismiss.

name: Accordion
description: Expandable Q&A rows revealing answers on tap.

name: Stepper
description: Minus/plus control for numeric values.

name: Rating
description: Star display or input for scores.
